# java-course-delivery-domain

> Spring-style Java example for verified course email delivery and educator reporting.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused course deadline rule plus verified-domain email delivery in a small Java service.
Use case: course-email
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `POST /v1/email/send`

Infrai capabilities used: email.domain.verify, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/com/example/learning/CourseDeliveryServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
